d: The 2026 US Midterm results have triggered a political shake-up in Washington. JD Vance has blamed the Iran war for Republican losses, claiming some Trump voters switched their support to Democrats. Trump has agreed that the conflict pushed up gasoline prices but defended the military action, saying, “We had to do.” Democrats have seized control of both the House and Senate, prompting Trump to congratulate them while warning he could “veto everything.” Meanwhile, Jim Jordan and Steve Scalise are reportedly preparing bids for House GOP leadership, as Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the…
